finalText:
All the same tenant-scoping pattern, no semantic collisions. So this is genuinely uniform and mechanical, just large.

Scope: ~90 files, all the same repetitive pattern (services/*, migrations, lib). Consistent single meaning throughout, no landmines from ambiguity.

Must not rename, two hard freezes:
- `vendor/reporting-sdk/**` — vendored, overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`, upstream-only
- `docs/openapi.yaml` and `lib/serialize.js`'s wire side — public API contract (`account_id` on Invoice/Order, query param), explicitly marked frozen, breaking change if touched

Also watch: `lib/audit.js` and old files under `migrations/` — audit log key and past migration files should get a new migration, not edits to history, plus audit.js needs its field synced not left stale.

Verdict: safe to sign off on the internal rename (services, repos, routes, new migration), as long as the wire-facing `account_id` in `serialize.js`/`openapi.yaml` and the vendored SDK stay untouched.
